But they made false statements to police about someone else causing injury. That's false testimony (伪证). Also "帮助伪证罪"? The law: Article 307 of Criminal Law: "伪证罪" (making false statements in judicial proceedings). Also "指使他人作伪证" also punishable. So charges: 故意伤害; 伪证. Possibly also "聚众斗殴"?
